This notebook reads saved results only. Use `study1-eivGP.R` and
`study1-competitors.R` for complete workloads on separate machines. The historical
view reads the selected merged original-grid export; it is not a merged report
of all calibrated comparisons. See [Study I reproduction](study1-README.md).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE)
if(params$action!="report")stop("This notebook is report-only")
if(!is.null(params$options$action)&&params$options$action!="report")stop("options cannot enable fitting")
here<-dirname(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE))
source(file.path(here,"study1.R"),local=TRUE)
root<-if(nzchar(params$results_root)) params$results_root else Sys.getenv("EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT")
if(!nzchar(root))stop("Set results_root or EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT.")
modern<-params$lane!="historical" || nzchar(params$component)
if(modern) {
  repo<-normalizePath(file.path(here,"../.."))
  controls<-modifyList(list(action=params$action,profile=params$profile,
    `mixing-plots`=params$mixing_plots,cores=as.character(params$cores),component=params$component,output=root),params$options)
  if(params$lane!="historical") {
    source(file.path(here,"common.R"),local=TRUE);numerical_package_check()
    source(file.path(here,"study1-common.R"),local=TRUE)
    controls$component<-NULL
    result<-study1_paper_workflow(params$lane,controls,repo)
  } else result<-study1_workflow(controls,repo)
} else result<-study1_analysis(root,params$action,params$profile,params$cores,
  tables_dir=if(nzchar(params$tables_dir))params$tables_dir else NULL,
  competitor_dir=if(nzchar(params$competitor_dir))params$competitor_dir else NULL,
  mixing_plots=params$mixing_plots)
```

## Method comparison

EIV-GP is fitted by our package. UC-GP, LVGP, and EzGP use their respective
packages through the package's comparison adapters. Original published predictors fit all `(X,C)` records and ignore calibration. Their `-CC` versions fit only calibrated records with continuous `(X,U)` and categorical `C`, integrating response-free test-input draws. PI-GP and CC-GP are supplementary diagnostics. MCSEs describe variation across replications, not within-fit MCMC error.

```{r scores, results='asis'}
if(params$action=="report" && !modern) {
  cat("Historical original-grid snapshot; calibrated comparisons are reported separately.\n\n")
  if(!nrow(result$diagnostics))cat("No diagnostic table was supplied with this export.\n\n")
  cat("Selected source:",result$source,"\n\n")
  print(eivGP::report_table(result$summary,caption="Scores and replication MCSEs"))
} else if(modern && (!is.null(result$complete_case)||!is.null(result$calibrated$complete_case))) {
  cc<-if(!is.null(result$calibrated))result$calibrated$complete_case else result$complete_case
  for(cell in names(cc)) if(is.data.frame(cc[[cell]]))
    print(eivGP::report_table(cc[[cell]],caption=paste(cell,"complete-case comparisons")))
} else print(result)
```

```{r comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if(params$action=="report" && !modern) print(eivGP::plot_comparison(result$summary,"RMSE"))
```

## Diagnostics

Passing one diagnostic does not establish convergence for every estimand.
The unfiltered summaries retain all completed scores. The shared
`convergence-report.R` / `.Rmd` separately reports optimizer and measurement
failures, unknown checks and pending jobs, with explicit denominators. Its paired
accuracy comparisons require documented passes for every applicable diagnostic.
Regimes remain separate; matched sample sizes and replication MCSE are reported.
See the reproduction guide for read-only snapshots of running experiments.

```{r diagnostics, results='asis'}
if(params$action=="report" && !modern) print(eivGP::report_table(eivGP::summarize_diagnostics(result$diagnostics)))
```

## Mixing plots

The package saves three mixing figures (PDF and PNG) by default after `report`
or `run`: R-hat versus bulk ESS, mean MCSE relative to posterior SD, and
unavailable diagnostic counts. These use saved parameter-level CSVs only;
no chains are refitted or target integrations recomputed. Raw and scientific
quantities stay separate. Missing diagnostics are not treated as passes.
Set `mixing_plots: false` (batch: `--mixing-plots=false`) to skip them.

```{r mixing-figures, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
plots<-if(modern) attr(result,"mixing_plots") else result$mixing_plots
pngs<-plots[grepl("[.]png$",plots)]
if(length(pngs)) knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(pngs))
```

For chain-level inspection, `eivGP::plot_mcmc(fit, parameters=c("V","r"))`
returns a customizable ggplot. Use `type="rank"`, `"acf"`, or `"running_mean"`
for complementary views. Supply named lists of chain vectors for scientific
functionals already computed on every retained draw. The package does not
silently recompute those expensive functionals for plotting.

```{r workflow-status, results='asis'}
if(modern) for(p in list.files(file.path(root,"complete-case"),pattern="status.csv",recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE))
  print(eivGP::report_table(read.csv(p)))
```

## Reproduction

Use `study1-eivGP.R` and `study1-competitors.R` for separate-machine execution.
Each covers its complete paper workload. This notebook rejects fitting actions.
Use the shared `convergence-report.R` to inspect saved or running experiments
without their resume gates, with a separate reporting library and output directory.
Never rename old caches to bypass source/protocol identity checks.

```{r session, echo=FALSE}
packageVersion("eivGP")
sessionInfo()
```
